searchText: MSRP $55,402. 2026 Forest River Aurora 24RBS is approximately 28' 1' in length with 1 slide. Features Home Entertainment Package GE Kitchen Suite Package Outdoor Kitchen Pass-Through Storage Exterior Sport and Travel Package More About This RV When you are ready to camp with your favorite person, this trailer offers the perfect couple's trailer with space for an overnight guest on the booth dinette. You will have a front bedroom with a walk-around queen bed, dual wardrobes and overhead cabinets for your belongings. The main living and kitchen area is spacious with a slide out dinette and sofa giving you more floor space, dining and relaxing seating, and extra sleeping space for friends once the furniture is easily setup. There is a wardrobe/pantry with washer/dryer prep next to the rear corner bathroom complete with a radius shower. The galley kitchen includes full amenities, plus there is an outside kitchen with a griddle and mini refrigerator. Everyone will enjoy the entertainment center when inside, and the 21' awning offers a covered outdoor living area, just grab your chairs from the pass-through compartment. Comfortability, usability, and quality is what you will find in each one of these Forest River Aurora travel trailers, toy haulers or destination trailers! They are designed with a superior build and packed full with industry leading, functional, and distinctive standard features. SolidStep entrance steps and a Safe-T rail door assist on main entry door to help you safely enter and exit the unit. The diamond plate rock guard will protect your unit from road debris and the nitrogen filled radial tires, which keep their pressure longer, offer better fuel economy. You will also find upgraded JBL Elite exterior speakers outside, an electric awning with multicolor lights and remote, plus flush mount baggage doors for easy packing. The interiors are beautifully designed with a deep undermount farm style sink, stainless steel appliances, and linoleum flooring in the slide outs which will be easy to clean. Come find your favorite model today!
